description: Captures how long a user waits on a Duck.ai response in the full Duck.ai tab, whether they leave while it is pending, and whether they come back to it.

name.description: The name of the application sending the event

version.description: The version of the app sending the event. Release builds are X.Y.Z; internal and nightly builds append the build number and channel suffix.

form_factor.description: The form factor of the current device

dev_mode.description: Whether the app is a debug build

platform.description: The platform the app is running on

type.description: The type of software sending the event

sample_rate.description: Sample rate for this event, between 0 and 1

is_first_daily_occurrence.description: Whether this is the first event completed with this feature name and status in the current UTC calendar day

name.description: The feature name for this event

status.description: The terminal status of the flow

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort selected for the prompt. Present only when an effort was selected

used_reasoning.description: Whether the prompt used reasoning (low, medium or high effort). Present from the start of the flow

used_extended_reasoning.description: Whether the prompt used extended reasoning (medium or high effort). Present from the start of the flow

user_requested_image_generation.description: Whether the user selected the image generation tool for the prompt. Present from the start of the flow

user_requested_web_search.description: Whether the user selected the web search tool for the prompt. Present from the start of the flow

status_reason.description: Reason the flow ended. The flow follows the chat, not the tab it was sent from. watched when the user stayed on the chat until the response finished, returned when the user came back to the chat after leaving, not_returned when the user never came back before the flow expired. Present on every event

failure_reason.description: Reason the flow failed. not_returned when the user never came back to the chat before the flow expired. Only present on FAILURE events

response_result.description: Outcome of the response as last observed. unknown until the page reports a terminal state. Unreliable when response_state_on_return is page_reloaded, because a reloaded page can report a truncated reply as ready. Present on every event

step.left.description: Parameter present when the user left the chat while the response was still loading

left_via.description: How the user left the chat. Present only when step.left is present

step.response_ready_while_away.description: Parameter present when the response finished while the user was away from the tab

step.returned.description: Parameter present when the user came back to the chat after leaving, in the same tab or another one

response_state_on_return.description: State of the response at the moment the user came back. page_reloaded when the page was reloaded after the app process was killed, so the reported state is not trusted. Present only when step.returned is present

step.prompt_after_return.description: Parameter present when the user submitted another prompt in the same chat after returning

prompt_to_leave_ms_bucketed.description: Time from prompt submission to the user leaving the tab, bucketed (lower end of bucket, in ms). -1 when the measured duration was negative. Present only when step.left is present

leave_to_return_ms_bucketed.description: Time from the user leaving the tab to coming back, bucketed (lower end of bucket, in ms). -1 when the measured duration was negative. Present only when step.returned is present

ready_to_return_ms_bucketed.description: Time from the response finishing while the user was away to the user coming back, bucketed (lower end of bucket, in ms). -1 when the measured duration was negative. Present only when the response finished while away and the user returned
